subject: Request: IRP overview + forensic logs for MedSys Health due diligence
messages:
From: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@medsyshealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:42:00 -0500
Subject: Request: IRP overview + forensic logs for MedSys Health due diligence

Hi Soojin,

MedSys is wrapping up vendor due diligence ahead of a pilot and our security team asked for Redwood's incident response plan summary and a sample export of auth/audit logs covering a recent timeframe. Specifically, they want:

- A concise IRP overview (who owns what, notification timelines, escalation contacts).
- Evidence that you retain and can export audit/auth logs (SAML, token issuance, admin actions) for a given date range.
- Any postmortem summary if there was an incident involving customer data in the last 12 months. PII redaction is fine.

Can you share a PDF summary and a secure location for logs? Procurement included; they may follow up on NDA/transfer steps. We need this by EOD Monday (US Eastern) if possible.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Rodriguez
Information Security — MedSys Health
alex.rodriguez@medsyshealth.com
(617) 555-0182

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: IRP overview + forensic logs for MedSys Health due diligence

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Attaching a short IRP summary (redwood_irp_summary_20270220.pdf) that covers roles, notification windows, and our escalation matrix. Also including S3 transfer instructions (s3_transfer_instructions.txt) — we can push a temporary, encrypted bundle to a pre-signed location once we agree on scope.

A couple quick clarifying questions so we prepare exactly what you need:

- Preferred log timeframe (start/end dates)? You mentioned "recent timeframe" — would a 7–14 day window around any event be sufficient, or do you need a specific month?
- Do you need raw logs (CSV/JSON) or a sanitized summary? We can provide both; raw logs will be redacted for any unrelated tenant identifiers.
- Is MedSys comfortable receiving logs via a pre-signed, time-limited S3 link? We can also use an encrypted share via our secure transfer portal (link below).

If you confirm timeframe and delivery mechanism I can get the export queued; security and legal (cc'd) will review before we hand off anything. If helpful, I can set a 30-minute call Monday morning to walk through the artifacts.

Secure transfer: https://redwood-secure-transfer.example/s/medsys-20270220

Thanks,

—Soojin Lee
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: redwood_irp_summary_20270220.pdf; s3_transfer_instructions.txt

From: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@medsyshealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 07:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: IRP overview + forensic logs for MedSys Health due diligence

Thanks Soojin. Good progress.

Preferred timeframe: Jan 10, 2027 — Jan 25, 2027 (this covers a period that flagged in our monitoring). We need:

- Auth events (SAML assertion, token issuance, admin console logins) for all MedSys tenant identifiers.
- Admin activity (role changes, API key rotations) and any alerts triggered by abnormal activity.

We prefer raw logs in newline-delimited JSON if possible. Redact other customer IDs; preserve MedSys IDs and timestamps.

Also, to be clear: do you have any incident postmortem that touches MedSys data in that window? If yes, we need a redacted postmortem (one page summary + timeline) as part of the deliverable.

Procurement is okay with S3 pre-signed; please ensure the link is time-limited and IP-restricted if possible.

—Alex

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: IRP overview + forensic logs for MedSys Health due diligence

Alex — thanks for the specifics.

Deliverables attached and notes below:

Attachments delivered to secure transfer (and attached here):
- postmortem_medical_data_incident_20270115.pdf (redacted one-page summary + timeline)
- audit_logs_export_20270115-20270122.zip (newline-delimited JSON, includes auth events and admin actions; MedSys tenant IDs preserved)

Summary notes (high-level):
- Incident: On 2027-01-15 we observed an elevated rate of abnormal API keys usage tied to a misconfigured deployment. No evidence of exfiltration of patient PII tied to MedSys tenant IDs. Root cause: a credential rotation omission during a rolling deployment.
- Detection: Our runtime monitoring flagged anomalous token issuance patterns; SRE and Security engaged within 18 minutes.
- Containment & Remediation: Keys were revoked; affected instances were restarted with updated credentials; additional WAF rules deployed. Full remediation completed within 3 hours of detection.
- Notifications: Affected customers were notified per our notification windows; we provided mitigation steps and offered dedicated review calls.

Log package notes:
- Format: newline-delimited JSON. Files zipped and encrypted with AES-256; transfer via pre-signed S3 expiring in 48 hours.
- Redaction: All non-MedSys tenant IDs replaced with hashed tokens; timestamps preserved in UTC.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you can access the secure transfer link.
2) Let us know if you want additional fields (e.g., full request payloads) — that may require an additional narrow approval from legal.
3) If you'd like a walk-through, I can book a 30-minute slot Tuesday morning PST.

Quote of your earlier note for context:
> Preferred timeframe: Jan 10, 2027 — Jan 25, 2027

I will hold the export for the window you specified (Jan 10–25) and will adjust if you confirm a narrower range. Grace (Security Ops) and David (Legal) are cc'd to expedite any approvals for expanded artifacts.

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin Lee
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0224
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime

Attachment stubs: postmortem_medical_data_incident_20270115.pdf (PDF, redacted), audit_logs_export_20270115-20270122.zip (encrypted zip)
